words.definition_en: to transfer data from the internet to a device
example_sentences: Download the app before the trip.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to make a copy of data in case the original is lost
example_sentences: Always back up your files before an update.

words.definition_en: (of a screen or program) to stop responding
example_sentences: The screen froze in the middle of the call.

words.definition_en: a small, usually temporary, problem with a system or device
example_sentences: There was a glitch in the payment system.

words.definition_en: a fault in a computer program
example_sentences: The update fixed a major bug.

words.definition_en: a new version of software that fixes or improves it
example_sentences: Install the update before you continue.

words.definition_en: to restart a computer or device
example_sentences: Try rebooting the router if the wifi is down.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to end a session on a computer system
example_sentences: Remember to log out on shared computers.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to prepare a device or system for use
example_sentences: It took a while to set up the new printer.

words.definition_en: to identify and fix the cause of a technical problem
example_sentences: Our support team can help troubleshoot the issue.

words.definition_en: software designed to damage or gain unauthorised access to a system
example_sentences: The email attachment contained malware.

words.definition_en: the fraudulent practice of tricking people into giving personal information online
example_sentences: Be careful of phishing emails asking for your password.

words.definition_en: an incident where protected data is accessed without authorisation
example_sentences: The company reported a major data breach last year.

words.definition_en: the practice of protecting systems and data from digital attacks
example_sentences: The firm invests heavily in cybersecurity.

words.definition_en: computer systems able to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence
example_sentences: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work.

words.definition_en: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
example_sentences: The algorithm recommends videos based on your history.

words.definition_en: to make a process operate automatically, without human control
example_sentences: We automated most of the repetitive tasks.

words.definition_en: to convert a process or information into digital form
example_sentences: The company digitalised all its paper records.

words.definition_en: the amount of data that can be transferred over a network
example_sentences: Video calls use a lot of bandwidth.

words.definition_en: a delay between an action and its effect, often in a connection
example_sentences: There was a noticeable lag during the video call.

words.definition_en: (of a video) to pause and load before continuing to play
example_sentences: The video keeps buffering with this connection.

words.definition_en: the amount of time spent using a screen device
example_sentences: Parents try to limit their children's screen time.

words.definition_en: (of content) to spread very quickly online
example_sentences: The video went viral within hours.

words.definition_en: a person who affects opinions or purchases through social media
example_sentences: The brand partnered with several influencers.

words.definition_en: someone who posts deliberately offensive or provocative content online
example_sentences: She ignored the trolls in the comments.

words.definition_en: to spend excessive time scrolling through negative news online
example_sentences: He admitted to doomscrolling before bed most nights.

words.definition_en: a period of avoiding electronic devices
example_sentences: They went on a digital detox during the holiday.

words.definition_en: a system that requires payment to access online content
example_sentences: The article is behind a paywall.

words.definition_en: easy for people to use or understand
example_sentences: The new interface is much more user-friendly.

words.definition_en: easy to use without needing much explanation
example_sentences: The app has an intuitive design.

words.definition_en: no longer used because something newer exists
example_sentences: That technology is now obsolete.

words.definition_en: introducing new methods or ideas; highly original
example_sentences: The research was seen as groundbreaking.

words.definition_en: to fundamentally change the way an established industry operates
example_sentences: Streaming services disrupted the entire music industry.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to increase the size or extent of something, especially a business
example_sentences: The startup scaled up quickly after the investment.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to introduce a product or service gradually
example_sentences: The update will be rolled out over the next month.

words.definition_en: to test a product before its official public release
example_sentences: Users beta tested the app for two weeks.

words.definition_en: an early model of a product used for testing
example_sentences: The team built a working prototype in a week.

words.definition_en: the point where a user interacts with a computer system
example_sentences: The interface is clean and easy to navigate.

words.definition_en: to combine one system or process with another
example_sentences: The new tool integrates with our existing software.

words.definition_en: able to work together without problems
example_sentences: Make sure the charger is compatible with your phone.

words.definition_en: smooth and without interruption or difficulty
example_sentences: The transition to the new system was seamless.

words.definition_en: a work arrangement combining office and remote work
example_sentences: The company adopted a hybrid working model.

words.definition_en: a call in which participants can see each other via video
example_sentences: We had a video call with the client.

words.definition_en: to show your computer screen to others during a video call
example_sentences: Can you screen share the presentation?

words.definition_en: to turn off the sound, especially a microphone
example_sentences: Please mute your microphone when you're not speaking.
